decisions.statement: The restart notice is asked for before the requested action is cleared.
Clearing the requested action is tried twice.
A failure to clear the requested action is logged and swallowed.
Each clear attempt is capped at five seconds.
A pending re-exec turns restart-now into a break.
A pending re-exec sets no resume.
The rail route resumes with an empty first prompt.
A rail route sets the driver to deferred-notice.
Any other route sets the driver to argv-prompt.
A clear that never lands still resumes the session.

definition: what a restart-now action asks of the loop once the child has gone
